title: A Circle of Radius 4: How Big Can the Triangle Get? | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
A circle of radius 4 sits inside a triangle with whole-number sides, touching two sides 6 away from corner A. How big can the perimeter get? Vantee names every side with equal tangent pieces, finds the area two ways (radius times half-perimeter, and Heron's formula), then hunts for whole-number answers with a table and a factoring trick. You'll see why 81 is exactly half the right answer, and get a radius-3 version to try yourself.
